prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption copy, finish layout, and home wait-info changes showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across almost all tests.
Evidence remains thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path hint, choose_path redesign, finish notification, home new_flow, and sign_in redesign, as each has only 1 test so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -1.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: -2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, hint: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: -8.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: -1.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, notification: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -2.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -10.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] adoption_photo_style_selector_screen: Add a dedicated art style selection screen during photo upload to let users choose how their custom pet looks before generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption has the lowest step conversion at 60.9%.)
1: [home, redesign] waiting_screen_split_layout_redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout separating live setup progress from tips on desktop companion behavior. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s), creating high drop-off and potential user confusion about whether generation stalled.)
2: [finish, new_flow] home_intro_quick_commands_flow: Add a secondary flow screen after home intro to set initial desktop pet behavior and control shortcuts. (why: 7 support emails mentioned confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet post-onboarding.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] story_mode_preview_screen: Insert a preview screen after story mode demonstrating real desktop pet features before choosing an onboarding path. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating users pause to understand what the desktop pet does.)
4: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_account_sync_warning_hint: Add a clear warning hint on sign-in clarifying that signing in secures existing pet profiles across app restarts. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing back into their account.)
5: [adoption, layout] pick_friend_two_column_layout: Switch the pick_friend screen to a two-column layout showing pet stats alongside visual selection. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and a high median time of 89s.)
6: [home, notification] waiting_screen_completion_notification: Enable system desktop notifications when generation finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Users wait a mean of 2336s during the home waiting step, causing background drop-off without notifications.)
7: [finish, incentive] home_intro_desktop_visibility_badge: Display a prominent reminder badge on home intro showing the global shortcut key to toggle pet visibility. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on desktop and 3 tickets reported confusion on hiding/controlling pets.)
8: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_clarity_tip_carousel: Add photo quality hints to the upload_photos screen to guide users toward better source image quality. (why: Support received emails regarding custom pets failing or looking wrong after adoption.)
